svg.title: Youssef & Maii - Cup V2: monogram only, 30 mm high (recommended - TBC)
svg.desc: Monogram only on ivory/white cup; botanical removed for a cleaner cup. Place on the manufacturer dieline, front centre. FINAL DIELINE, PRINTABLE AREA, SCALE, BLEED AND SAFE AREA MUST BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE BEFORE PRODUCTION.
